create_bitnet_config: create a BitNetConfig instance with default model parameters for the BitNet architecture
initialize_bitnet_model: initialize a BitNetModel using a BitNetConfig instance for model construction
access_model_config: access the configuration from an instantiated BitNetModel via the model.config attribute
configure_bitnet_parameters: configure BitNet model parameters like vocab_size, hidden_size, and attention heads
customize_rope_parameters: customize rope_parameters for positional encoding in the BitNetConfig
